items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Investor Day And Earnings
items.summary: Sandisk’s updated fair value estimate has moved from US$1,772.91 to US$2,126.17 in the latest model, which is roughly a 20% uplift in the price target. This reset lines up with the recent surge in analyst attention after investor day and earnings, as firms weigh Sandisk’s long term growth framework against what is already reflected in the stock.
